verdict.rationale: Exa documents asynchronous job-style products. Websets results "arrive asynchronously through the dashboard, API, or webhooks" with HTTP callbacks as items are enriched, and pricing lists "Async deep research, list building, and enrichment." However, there is no evidence of a batch endpoint for submitting many search queries at once, so high-volume query workloads are only indirectly served through Websets and Agent runs. Missing for 10: a documented batch submission API for bulk search/contents queries, job status and polling semantics for high-volume workloads, throughput or limit details for batch jobs, and independent corroboration of async throughput.
